name: McGhee

origin.summary: Honors Army Corporal Ryan C. McGhee, 21, killed in action on May 13, 2009, in central Iraq during his fourth deployment, serving with the 3rd Battalion, 75th Ranger Regiment. A 30-minute AMRAP of heavy deadlifts, push-ups, and box jumps — long, heavy, and relentless.

description: A 30-minute AMRAP of heavy deadlifts, push-ups, and box jumps — a long-format triplet at modest, uneven rep counts.
source_notes: crossfit.com/benchmark/mcghee (official CrossFit Hero WOD page), retrieved 2026-07-09
